WITH config_values AS (
  SELECT jsonb_object_agg(key,value) AS values
  FROM settings
  WHERE key = ANY (ARRAY[
    'RECOMMENDATION_MAX_CATEGORIES_PER_RUN','RECOMMENDATION_MIN_OPPORTUNITY_SCORE',
    'RECOMMENDATION_CONTEXT_LIMIT','RECOMMENDATION_PROMPT_VERSION','RECOMMENDATION_MODEL'
  ])
), configured AS (
  SELECT greatest(coalesce((values ->> 'RECOMMENDATION_MAX_CATEGORIES_PER_RUN')::integer,5),0) AS max_categories,
         coalesce(nullif(values ->> 'RECOMMENDATION_MODEL',''),'nvidia/nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b') AS recommendation_model,
         coalesce(nullif(values ->> 'RECOMMENDATION_PROMPT_VERSION',''),'v1') AS prompt_version,
         coalesce(values,'{}'::jsonb) AS configuration
  FROM config_values
), selected AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT candidate.*
  FROM configured
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL select_recommendation_candidates(configured.max_categories) candidate
), counted AS (
  SELECT count(*)::integer AS value FROM selected
), started AS (
  INSERT INTO pipeline_runs (workflow,status,items_received,metadata)
  SELECT '08 - TrendLens - Recommendation AI','running',counted.value,
         jsonb_build_object(
           'recommendation_model',configured.recommendation_model,
           'prompt_version',configured.prompt_version,
           'configuration',configured.configuration,
           'input_scope','aggregated_only'
         )
  FROM configured CROSS JOIN counted
  RETURNING id,started_at
)
SELECT started.id AS pipeline_run_id,started.started_at AS run_started_at,
       configured.recommendation_model,configured.prompt_version,
       counted.value AS candidate_count,selected.*
FROM started
CROSS JOIN configured
CROSS JOIN counted
LEFT JOIN selected ON true
ORDER BY selected.opportunity_score DESC NULLS LAST,selected.category;

WITH updated AS (
  UPDATE pipeline_runs
  SET finished_at=coalesce(finished_at,current_timestamp),
      status=CASE
        WHEN items_failed > 0 AND items_processed = 0 THEN 'failed'
        WHEN items_failed > 0 THEN 'partial'
        ELSE 'success'
      END,
      duration_seconds=coalesce(duration_seconds,extract(epoch FROM (current_timestamp-started_at))),
      metadata=metadata || jsonb_build_object(
        'candidates_selected',items_received,
        'recommendations_created',items_processed,
        'recommendations_skipped',items_skipped,
        'recommendations_failed',items_failed,
        'model_calls_estimated',api_calls
      )
  WHERE id=$1::bigint
  RETURNING *
)
SELECT id AS pipeline_run_id,workflow,status,items_received,items_processed,
       items_skipped,items_failed,api_calls,duration_seconds,metadata,started_at,finished_at
FROM updated;

WITH args AS (
  SELECT
    $1::bigint AS run_id,$2::text AS category,$3::timestamptz AS period_start,
    $4::timestamptz AS period_end,$5::text AS platform,$6::char(2) AS region,
    $7::varchar(16) AS language,$8::numeric AS opportunity_score,
    $9::numeric AS virality_score,$10::numeric AS monetization_score,
    $11::numeric AS consistency_score,$12::text AS summary,
    $13::jsonb AS recommended_formats,$14::jsonb AS recommended_hooks,
    $15::jsonb AS risks,$16::jsonb AS monetization_notes,
    $17::jsonb AS evidence_json,$18::text AS evidence_hash,
    $19::text AS model,$20::text AS prompt_version,
    $21::text AS source_calculation_version,$22::text AS source_opportunity_version
), inserted AS (
  INSERT INTO recommendations (
    category,period_start,period_end,platform,region,language,
    opportunity_score,virality_score,monetization_score,consistency_score,
    summary,recommended_formats,recommended_hooks,risks,monetization_notes,
    evidence_json,evidence_hash,model,prompt_version,
    source_calculation_version,source_opportunity_version
  )
  SELECT
    args.category,args.period_start,args.period_end,args.platform,args.region,args.language,
    args.opportunity_score,args.virality_score,args.monetization_score,args.consistency_score,
    args.summary,
    ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(args.recommended_formats)),
    ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(args.recommended_hooks)),
    ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(args.risks)),
    ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(args.monetization_notes)),
    args.evidence_json,args.evidence_hash,args.model,args.prompt_version,
    args.source_calculation_version,args.source_opportunity_version
  FROM args
  ON CONFLICT (
    category,period_start,period_end,platform,region,language,
    prompt_version,model,evidence_hash
  ) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING id
), updated AS (
  UPDATE pipeline_runs
  SET items_processed=items_processed+CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inserted) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
      items_skipped=items_skipped+CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inserted) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
      api_calls=api_calls+1
  FROM args
  WHERE pipeline_runs.id=args.run_id
  RETURNING pipeline_runs.*
)
SELECT updated.id AS pipeline_run_id,updated.items_processed,updated.items_skipped,
       updated.items_failed,args.category,
       (SELECT id FROM inserted) AS recommendation_id,
       EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inserted) AS recommendation_created
FROM updated CROSS JOIN args;

parameters.query:
WITH args AS (
  SELECT $1::bigint AS run_id,$2::text AS category,$3::text AS message,
         $4::text AS model,$5::text AS prompt_version,$6::text AS evidence_hash
), logged AS (
  INSERT INTO pipeline_errors (
    pipeline_run_id,workflow,node,error_type,error_message,external_id,retry_count,metadata
  )
  SELECT args.run_id,'08 - TrendLens - Recommendation AI','Persistir recomendação','recommendation_persistence_error',
         left(regexp_replace(args.message,'(?i)(authorization|api[_-]?key|token|password|secret)[^ ,;]*','[REDACTED]','g'),4000),
         args.category,2,jsonb_build_object(
           'category',args.category,'recommendation_model',args.model,
           'prompt_version',args.prompt_version,'evidence_hash',args.evidence_hash,
           'input_scope','aggregated_only'
         )
  FROM args
  RETURNING id
), updated AS (
  UPDATE pipeline_runs
  SET items_failed=items_failed+1,api_calls=api_calls+1
  FROM args
  WHERE pipeline_runs.id=args.run_id
  RETURNING pipeline_runs.id,pipeline_runs.items_processed,pipeline_runs.items_failed
)
SELECT updated.*,(SELECT id FROM logged) AS pipeline_error_id
FROM updated;
